reviews.text: I went today with my puppy and the doctor was super friendly, the two women who help him are even better, and the prices are very good. This will be my vet. 10/10

Dr. George is my absolute favorite veterinarian! ❤️ There is always such a warm, friendly, and professional atmosphere at his office. The two wonderful women who work with him are always incredibly kind, caring, and helpful.

My dogs, Coco and Pooky, feel very comfortable and well cared for every time we visit, which means so much to me. I completely trust Dr. George and his team and truly appreciate the care and kindness they show my dogs. 🐾❤️

Highly recommend!
Very caring and compassionate. They really care about your pet.

Great experience. They've been taking very good care of my 3 boys (pitts) for some time and they e been a great help!!!
Go check them out for yourself and you'll see first hand what I'm talking about.
Experienced, friendly, caring staff and  reasonable rates.
Dr. George and staff are absolutely amazing. Went for the first time and had a very good experience. Knowledgeable, kind, great prices, and Dr. George really cares. HIGHLY recommend
I love the attention given to my pet and it's very accessible.
First time going in, and I wish I would’ve known about them sooner. Doctor was great and the staff was amazing. Thank you all for making my babies visit super comfortable.

I am a client of Diversey Animal Hospital for several years.  I am Mexican, born in USA and bilingual.  I am familiar with the staff and know the “blond blue eyed” tech to which you are referring.  Actually, this tech is of Mexican heritage and positively charming.  Perhaps, due to the language barrier you misunderstood.  I know visits are by appointment only and if you phoned for an appointment they would have directed you to a hospital that spoke Spanish.   I think it is important that clients clearly understand what is being told to them regarding the health of their animal.  Broken English just isn’t safe.  It’s in your best interest to learn the English language.  It is the language of the USA.

Wow! I live near the area and I am trying to find a vet near me, but just by reading all the reviews about this place it blew my mind.  Apparently the pricing is affordable and the vet is great, but there is an issue with a "blond lady with blue eyes that appears to be the receptionist and to be racist", she won't rendered services if you dont speak English!!! 🤯🤯🤯.  I hope this vet or business owner reads these reviews because he/she just lost another new customer if we are not treated with respect. No way I am bringing my cat to a very disrespectful environment and I hope this lady gets some disciplinary action and get relocated to another location, maybe Lincoln Park or to a white prominent community (sarcasm).
I love this place an the people that work here .the vet tech Monica is amazing my dogs love her an dr George.

My cat was sick, and I made an appointment here. I previously took my other cat to this clinic, and the doctor treated me very well and solved our problem. For this reason, I now made another appointment here. When we arrived, the woman who was treating us asked what was wrong with our cat. We told her he was sick and had a runny nose, which is why he needed care. All of this in very few words since we don't speak English natively. At that moment, the doctor's assistant came out and, with a very ugly face, told us we had to go somewhere else to get care because we don't speak English. We told her that it was no problem, as they had previously treated us without any problem. She replied that she doesn't treat unvaccinated cats because they were dangerous. I then showed her my cat's vaccination paper, and without even looking at it, she told us no and that we had to go somewhere that spoke Spanish. She was a blonde woman with light blue eyes. We left the place feeling really ashamed and embarrassed. In the years we've lived in Chicago, no one has ever discriminated against us or kicked us out of a place for not speaking English natively. I told her I thought it was very discriminatory and racist on her part. So, I don't recommend this service. I find the discriminatory attitude of the person who serves there very bad.
Refused to see my dog because we did not speak English that is discrimination

I am happy to take my dogs at this clinic.  Dr. is very good and professional and the staff they are always for you , and the most important thing is that the Dr really cares about the pets, no just money . Also, it is very affordable prices.
Called the receptionist to ask about pricing/an appointment for my dog’s hernias and the receptionist said, “I don’t think dogs have hernias.” What kind of business are you running?

I often go here for my cat and dog needs. They offer very affordable and reasonable prices. I love going here to update vaccines on my pets.
My only issue is, the staff will be very rude to you if you only speak Spanish.
Again, the price for the service is amazing, but they don’t have to be so rude when customers want to give you business, but they only speak Spanish. Maybe hire a bilingual worker.

What an awful clinic! I only called to see if they would treat my sick cat, and just because I spoke to the person who answered in Spanish, she told me that they only speak English here and that if I didn't speak English, I couldn't come in. 😡 …

The good thing about this place are the prices compared to other vets. As a newer patient/client, the service has been consistently rude. When I called for my dog’s allergies, the person that answered was rude in telling me that appointments were far out and I should’ve refilled his medication even though I was trying to explain it didn’t really help, so she kept telling me it’s allergy season anyway, so I should just refill the medication. I ended up scheduling an appt for my dog, 2 weeks out, just in case. I asked the lady twice what time the appt was and she confirmed it was at 11 before we hung up. Then we show up for the appt at 11 and the entire staff started giving us attitude for showing up late stating the appt was at 9. I really hope service improves. I want to keep coming here, but we get attitude every time we reach out for anything and all we’re trying to do is help our dog.

Everyone was nice to me, I think the entire process took 20 minutes in/out. There was no fluff, and no BS. If you had a problem with the staff, perhaps you’re due some introspection on how you treat others.
Really good service and great price
Nice service I recommend 💯 …
Great office!!! Dr George  and staff are great!!!
Good service 👍 …
Excellent veterinarian and customer service :)
